title: Space Exploration: Rockets and Planets
description: Blast off into the amazing world of space travel and discover incredible facts about our solar system!

questions.q: How fast do rockets need to go to escape Earth's gravity?
questions.hint: It's 25 thousand miles per hour - faster than anything on Earth!

questions.q: Which planet has the biggest volcano in our solar system?
questions.hint: It's the red planet, and the volcano is called Olympus Mons!

questions.q: How many moons does Jupiter have?
questions.hint: It's almost 80 moons - Jupiter is like a mini solar system!

questions.q: What did Neil Armstrong say when he first stepped on the moon?
a: that's one small step for man
questions.hint: He talked about a small step for one person but a giant leap for everyone!

questions.q: How long does it take for light from the Sun to reach Earth?
questions.hint: About the same time it takes to eat breakfast!
